title: Seat Upgrade System Approves Passengers With No-Shows
description:
A flight seat-upgrade system spanning 5 files across 4 layers (models, repository, upgrade rules, service, route handler). `is_upgrade_eligible(passenger, flight)` should approve an upgrade only if **all** of: the passenger is gold or platinum tier, the passenger has zero prior no-shows, and an upgrade seat is available. Right now passengers with no-show history are getting approved while clean-record passengers get denied, and seat inventory is decremented even for denied requests. There are **multiple bugs across different files**. Trace the whole flow (`routes.py` -> `upgrade_service.py` -> `upgrade_rules.py`) before changing anything.

**Entry point**
`handle_upgrade_request(passenger_id, flight_id, repository) -> dict`

**Eligibility rule**
Approved only if `loyalty_tier` is gold or platinum AND `no_show_count == 0` AND `upgrade_seats_available > 0`. Seat inventory and `upgrades_used` should only change for approved requests.
